name: eye-impact
description: Wonder Scanner: confirmation burst when the gaze-driven eye gauge (Lupe's eye follows the player's gaze point from FaceLandmarker) opens fully and an action fires (wonder capture or spirit catch). Canvas 2D overlay + 2 DOM class toggles, mobile 60Hz.

phases.note: iris ring fills with eye().fill while the gaze point rests on the target (900ms wonder / 600ms spirit); decays 1.5/s when the gaze leaves or the face is lost
eyelids close and reopen (180ms); two shockwave rings (second +60ms), 12 radial sparks, HUD eye badge spring, brass edge flash, haptic [20,40,60], comboTone
sparks decelerate and fade; badge returns to scale 1; flash gone; 400ms rearm before the same target can fire again

reduced_motion.behavior: remove eyelid blink, shockwave rings, sparks and edge flash; keep the iris ring fill as the progress signal, the badge text/weight change, haptic and tone
